title: Bus Stop
description: A late-night bus stop across an empty street. Long quiet stretches, buses that go by without stopping, and now and then someone who waits and finally gets on. It never plays the same way twice.
ogAlt: Bus Stop: a bus shelter at night painted like an anime film, under a street lamp, with shopfronts, utility wires and warm lit windows across the street
canvasLabel: Animated anime-style bus stop at night across an empty street, where buses pass and now and then someone waits and gets on
